# GitHub Copilot instructions

The provider-neutral instructions in `.ai/` are authoritative for this
repository.

Before proposing or making changes, read:

- `.ai/instructions.md`
- `.ai/architecture.md`
- Relevant files under `.ai/conventions/`
- Relevant workflows under `.ai/skills/`

Preserve unrelated changes and do not perform Terraform apply, state changes,
cloud-side operations, commits, or pushes without explicit user approval.
